items.t: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) Lands First SiRNA MG Therapy With More Cancer Data Ahead
items.sum: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (NasdaqGS:REGN) received FDA approval for Livsayis (cemdisiran), the first siRNA therapy for generalized myasthenia gravis. Livsayis is cleared for adult patients with generalized myasthenia gravis and is designed for infrequent dosing compared with many existing treatments.
